dict.string: Cranny controls Music and Spotify to show and change what is playing when the system media source is unavailable.
Cranny shows your upcoming events and meeting links in the notch. It never edits or uploads them.

Cranny shows a camera preview in the Mirror widget. Video is never recorded.
Cranny shows when Bluetooth devices such as headphones connect, and their battery level.
Cranny listens to system audio output to animate the music visualizer. Audio is never recorded or stored.
Cranny keeps the files you drop on the notch in its Tray and saves pipeline results next to them or in Downloads.
